dct_description_sm: This layer depicts the actual geographic position of public paths, including walking trails and multi-use paths commonly found in park settings or adjacent to road corridors. The paths are categorized by their surface material type, such as brick, concrete, dirt/sand, gravel, natural, pavement, stone, or wood. The dataset is regularly updated with the latest imagery acquisitions to ensure accuracy and completeness.
